seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Chanhassen, MN for 2026: tree lighting with live reindeer and Santa, Tour of Lights, storytime and a gingerbread contest.
lede: Chanhassen packs its holiday season into a downtown tree lighting with live reindeer, a month of lights and a gingerbread contest.
celebrates: Chanhassen's parks and recreation department runs a short list of free-spirited traditions. The Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Center Park on December 5 brings live reindeer, bonfires, s'mores, carolers and Santa, and the Tour of Lights lets families drive the neighborhood displays from December 5 to 31. A gingerbread house contest takes entries at City Hall from December 1 to 3, and nearby Victoria holds Light Up Victoria on December 3.
lastyear: The city's photo from the 2022 tree lighting is still on its holiday events page, and this year the ceremony moves back downtown to the newly renovated City Center Park, according to the local newsletter What's Chanhappenin. The Tour of Lights and gingerbread contest are listed again for 2026 on the same city page.
facts: Chanhassen's annual Tree Lighting Ceremony moves back downtown to City Center Park in 2026 after the park's renovation. The Tour of Lights runs 27 nights, December 5 to 31, from 5 to 9 pm. The gingerbread contest costs $5 per submission.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Chanhassen. The Minnesota Landscape Arboretum's Northern Lights display, which our Chaska page covers, is nearby. For trains, the Everly Express at Everly Farms in Minnetrista, CPKC's Holiday Train stops on December 14 and the Holly Trolley in Minneapolis are the closest verified options.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Chanhassen for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events across Chanhassen and Victoria, 4 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (Gingerbread House Decorating Contest at Chanhassen City Hall) through December 31 (Chanhassen Tour of Lights), with the Light Up Victoria community event (December 3), the Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Center Park (December 5) and Winter Wonderland Storytime (December 9) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
